name: mle-bench-select
description: MLE-Bench-Select is a text-based benchmark for model selection tasks that evaluates models on their ability to choose the best completion/answer among candidates. It measures selection accuracy across curated selection problems drawn from diverse NLP scenarios. The benchmark is designed for automatic evaluation of ranking/selection behavior rather than generative quality.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark with limited but growing adoption in evaluation-oriented NLP research.
